title: Web search for a fact, source cited

steps.post: @{agent} using web search, find the year in which version 0.9.0 of the Python programming language was first released, and give me the URL of the page you used.

groundTruth.note: February 1991. Any reputable page (Wikipedia, python.org history, a retrospective) is acceptable.

pass: The reply gives 1991 and a URL that the turn received in a web::search result or read with web::fetch or web::navigate.

checks.text: web::search was called before any page read.
The cited URL appears in a tool result of the turn.
